title: Text model routing changed
summary:
Text model routing and token caps changed, CapyIMG joined Creative Projects, and the request pipeline got a modular rewrite.

`openai-large` now resolves to GPT-5 Nano instead of GPT-4.1, while `openai-fast` remains on GPT-4.1 Nano. Text requests also gained backend-model-ID aliases for Mistral Small 3.1 24B and DeepSeek R1 0528.

Text requests now use each model's configured `max_tokens` as a ceiling, falling back to the global limit when needed. Requests below the ceiling keep their chosen value; `openai-large` requests above 1024 tokens are capped at 1024.

@faelscarpato’s browser-based image generator was added to the Creative Projects directory. Its Brazilian Portuguese interface offers prompts, elements to avoid, image sizes, aspect ratios, and batches of one to four images.

highlights.title: More text model aliases
highlights.text: Text requests now recognize backend model IDs for Mistral Small 3.1 24B and DeepSeek R1 0528. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
